questions.exp: The RST flag immediately resets the connection, unlike FIN which closes it gracefully.

questions.q: Unlike a vulnerability assessment, a penetration test

never touches the live system or its network

questions.q: The plant Cuscuta (dodder) growing on a host plant is an example of
questions.exp: Cuscuta is a parasitic climber that draws nutrients from its host.

questions.q: An orchid growing on the branch of a mango tree is an example of
questions.exp: The epiphytic orchid benefits (support, light) while the tree is neither harmed nor helped.

questions.q: What percent of 2 hours is 15 minutes?
A boat goes 10 km/h in still water and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long will it take to go 36 km downstream?
questions.exp: Downstream speed = 12 km/h; time = 36/12 = 3 hours.

questions.q: The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. What is its total surface area?
questions.exp: Side = 7 cm; surface area = 6 x 49 = 294 cm².

questions.q: What is the smallest number that must be added to 1000 to make it divisible by 7?
A school has 40 students in Class VI, 50 in VII, 60 in VIII and 50 in IX. What percent of all students are in Class VIII?
In a certain code, 'DOG' is written as 'GRJ'. On the same pattern, how is BIHAR written?
questions.exp: Each letter is shifted three places forward: B→E, I→L, H→K, A→D, R→U, giving ELKDU.

questions.q: Find the next number: 3, 7, 16, 35, 74, ?
Heart : Pump :: Kidney : ?
questions.exp: The heart pumps blood; the kidney filters blood.

questions.q: Which of the following months is the odd one out?
questions.exp: March, May and August have 31 days; June has 30 days.

questions.q: P is the brother of Q. R is the mother of Q. S is the father of R. T is the mother of S. How is P related to T?
questions.exp: T is the mother of S, S is the father of R, and R is the mother of P. So T is P's great-grandmother and P (male) is her great-grandson.
